newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal 10-yr bond future breaks 106 resistance.
newsitem.headline: Portugal 10-yr bond future breaks 106 resistance.

text.p: Portugal's 10-year December bond future broke through resistance at 106 points, and yield spreads of 10-year cash bonds against Bunds dropped below 125 basis points for the first time, dealers said.
"We broke resistance at 106 in futures and 10-year bonds narrowed the spread against Germany to under 125 bp, an all-time low," said a fixed rate director.
He added: "The rise of peripheral markets and the expectation of a cut in Portuguese official rates is the reason for this strong rise, and besides that the market is short of paper."
December 1996 10-year futures rose 0.67 points to 106.05. The yield of February 2006 cash bonds was 7.04 percent, a record low with a yield spread of 121 basis points against April 2006 Bunds.
On Friday, 10-year cash bonds closed to yield 7.13 percent.
